PF2EGrimoire.Title: Grimoire

Open.Name: Open Grimoire
Open.Hint: Opens the Grimoire for your controlled token's character, or your assigned character.

Warning.NotCharacter: Select a character's token, or assign yourself a character, to open the Grimoire.

PF2EGrimoire.CastAt: Cast at rank {rank} ({source}). Right-click for other sources.

Error.SpellNotFound: That spell or spellcasting entry no longer exists on this character.

Cost.Overcharge: Overcharge: DC 10 flat check, breaks or destroys the wand
Cost.OverchargeRepeat: Destroys the wand: already overcharged today

Staff.NotHeld: Not held: hold the staff to cast from it
Staff.NoSlots: {actor} has no spell slots, so can't prepare a staff.
Staff.ChooseHint: {actor} carries more than one staff. Which one do you prepare today?

Editor.Drop: Drag a spell here to add it at
Editor.Empty: No spells on this staff yet.
Editor.Manual: Edited by hand: the description isn't read any more.
Editor.NotASpell: Only spells can go on a staff.
Editor.NoSource: {spell} has no compendium source, so it can't be added to a staff.

Boost.Button: Add charges from a spell slot (once a day)
Boost.Used: Already added charges from a slot today
Boost.Title: Add charges from a spell slot
Boost.Hint: Expend one of your prepared spell slots to add charges equal to its rank to {staff}. You can do this once a day.

Import.Notice: Staves from the PF2e Staves module ({count}). Import them to use them here.
Import.Title: Import from PF2e Staves
Import.Intro: This moves {actor}'s staves from PF2e Staves into the Grimoire:
Import.Line: {staff}: its spell list, and {charges} charges for today
Import.Missing: {entry}: no matching staff found, left as it is
Import.Warning: The PF2e Staves spellcasting entries and their spells are then deleted from the character. This can't be undone.
Import.NoneCarried: The imported staff isn't carried, so it won't show in the Grimoire until it is.

Overcharge.Title: Overcharge wand
Overcharge.Confirm: Cast {spell} from {wand} again? After the spell, you roll a DC {dc} flat check. On a success the wand is broken; on a failure it is destroyed.
Overcharge.ConfirmRepeat: {wand} was already overcharged today. Overcharging it again destroys it, and no spell is cast. Continue?
Overcharge.Success: Overcharge flat check (DC {dc}): success. {wand} is broken.
Overcharge.Failure: Overcharge flat check (DC {dc}): failure. {wand} is destroyed.
Overcharge.RepeatDestroyed: {actor} overcharged {wand} a second time today. It is destroyed and no spell is cast.

Reason.cannot-cast: Not on any of your spell lists
Reason.broken: Broken: repair it before using it again
Reason.not-prepared: You haven't prepared this staff today

Priority.Title: Casting priority
Priority.Hint: When more than one source can cast a spell at a rank, a click uses the highest one here. Wand overcharge and staff + slot are never picked automatically.

Filter.NoMatches: No spells match the current filter.

Tags.Add: Add a tag and press Enter

Table.RankHint: Base rank: C for cantrips, F for focus spells
Table.CastHint: Cast at rank: click a button to cast, right-click for every source

Warning.EndsAura: Overflow: your kinetic aura deactivates after this.
Warning.WastesInfusion: Wastes {infusion}, which needs an Elemental Blast.

Keybinding.Name: Open Kinetic Gate
Keybinding.Hint: Opens the kineticist dashboard for your controlled token's character, or your assigned character.

Automation.Name: Kineticist automation
Automation.Hint: Follow kineticists' chat cards: an overflow impulse ends the kinetic aura and its stance, infusions are tracked until the impulse they modify, and players are warned when an infusion is wasted or a second overflow is used in a round.

Notice.InfusionWasted: {infusion} was wasted: {item} isn't what it modifies.
Notice.ChainContinues: Chain Infusion: blast {blasts} of {max}. If it hit, blast another creature within range of the target.
Notice.ChainEnded: Chain Infusion: the chain ends after {blasts} blasts. Roll damage once for every creature hit.
Notice.OverflowTwice: {item} is a second overflow impulse this round. You can use only one per round.
Notice.ChannelRider: {item} is part of your Channel Elements action.
Notice.AuraEnded: Your kinetic aura is now dormant. Channel Elements to reactivate it.
Notice.AuraEndedWithStances: Your kinetic aura is now dormant, and {stances} ended with it. Channel Elements to reactivate it.

Aura.DismissHint: Deactivate your kinetic aura. Stance impulses end with it.
Aura.ChannelHint: Activate your kinetic aura. As part of this action you can use a 1-action Elemental Blast or a 1-action stance impulse.

Impulse.FreeWithChannel: Part of Channel Elements: no extra action
Impulse.Infused: The primed infusion applies to this

Overflow.ReadyHint: You can use one overflow impulse this round.
Overflow.UsedHint: You've used an overflow impulse this round. You can use only one per round, even after you reactivate your aura.

Banner.NextBlast: Your next action must be an Elemental Blast, or the infusion is wasted.
Banner.NextImpulse: Your next action must be an impulse, or the infusion is wasted.
Banner.ChainHint: If the last blast hit, blast a different creature within range of it. Your MAP applies. Roll damage once.
Banner.ChannelHint: You can include a 1-action Elemental Blast or a 1-action stance impulse in this action.

Effect.StanceHint: Stance impulse: ends when your kinetic aura deactivates

Infusion.ChainHint: Next Elemental Blast chains, up to {max} blasts

Blast.TwoActions: 2-action blast: adds your Constitution modifier as a status bonus to damage
Blast.Dormant: Your kinetic aura is dormant. Channel Elements to blast.
Blast.ChannelFree: A 1-action blast now is part of your Channel Elements action.
Blast.ChannelNeedsOne: Only a 1-action blast can be part of Channel Elements.

Block.AuraDormant: Your kinetic aura is dormant: impulses need it active.
Block.OverflowUsed: You've already used an overflow impulse this round.

Section.overflowHint: One per round; ends your aura

Badge.OverflowHint: Deactivates your kinetic aura. One overflow impulse per round.

Manage.ReflowHint: During daily preparations, swap an impulse feat for another of the same element. Resets when you Rest for the Night.
Manage.NoReflowHint: Kineticists gain Reflow Elements at 11th level. You can still browse every impulse your gates allow.
Manage.SlotHint: A replacement can be up to level {level}.
Manage.ReflowButtonHint: Swap this for another impulse of its element, up to level {level}.

Block.NoElement: Impulses that vary by element can't be reflowed.
Block.SeveralElements: Only impulses with exactly one element can be reflowed.

Manage.ReflowingHint: Choose a {element} impulse of level {level} or lower that you don't already have.
Manage.AnyElementHint: Works with whichever element you channel
Manage.Confirm: Replace {old} with {new}? This uses one of your reflows today ({left} of {perDay} left).
Manage.ConfirmNoneLeft: You've used today's reflows. Replace {old} with {new} anyway, for example to retrain?
Manage.NotFound: That impulse is no longer in the compendium.
